note: transactions admitted or refused by the topic manager's rules (spec section 12.1): a carrier's shape, beef, the record's rules, bucket, mineable, unlock, lock, signature, funding; a token's shape, beef, the record's rules, bucket, lock, signature, unmined, token-input, bucket-id; advertisements and hold outputs (beef, unmined, too-many); a sweep's beef, unmined, too-large; a piece refused; anything else not-bstore. Each case is the BEEF submitted (Atomic BEEF unless the case says otherwise; a token's is BEEF V1 of its parent then the token) and the previous coins it is admitted with, which decide what is retained and no verdict. Admission runs against the bucket and headers below with a host BEEF bound of 262,144 bytes and a sweep input bound of 1024. scriptsVerify says every input passes the script interpreter against the output it spends. Signatures are deterministic (RFC 6979).
